nodes.label: FreightProof SA Project
nodes.description: Cargo theft and disputed delivery evidence platform for South African logistics industry. INF4027W Honours Project, UCT 2026. 4 devs: Ciaran, Tim, Chiko, Tom.

nodes.label: FreightProof Architecture
nodes.description: Layered architecture: Frontends → FastAPI Backend → PostgreSQL/Redis/S3 → External integrations (Pulse, Parcel Perfect, IDVS, Hedera HCS).

nodes.label: Trip Phase Lifecycle
nodes.description: Plan-driven phase sequence: P0=trip_creation, P1=activation, P2=loading, P3=departure, P4=in_transit, P5=unloading, P6=confirmation. Length is data, not constant.

nodes.label: H0: Trip Creation Handshake
nodes.description: H0 HandshakeEvent created atomically with the Trip. sequence_number=0, status=PENDING, type=TRIP_CREATION. Includes journey lock hash.

nodes.label: POST /api/v1/trips Endpoint
nodes.description: Trip creation endpoint. Auth: Dispatcher JWT. Creates Trip row, TripTrailer rows, H0 HandshakeEvent, computes journey lock hash, queues Hedera anchor task, runs IDVS check.

nodes.label: GET /api/v1/trips Endpoint
nodes.description: Paginated trip list for Dispatcher. Query params: status (multi-value), driver_id, search, has_exceptions, from_date, to_date, page, page_size. Scope: caller's org only.

nodes.label: GET /api/v1/trips/{id}/manifest Endpoint
nodes.description: Parcel manifest for one trip. Returns 404 before loading starts. Fetched separately from trip detail to avoid bloat on list endpoints.

nodes.label: POST /trips/{id}/handshakes/h1/complete Endpoint
nodes.description: H1 Origin Gate-In completion. Driver submits GPS coords, gate photo. Validates Pulsit geofence. Returns 200 with H1 exception if checks fail (trip continues with alert).

nodes.label: POST /trips/{id}/handshakes/h2/complete Endpoint
nodes.description: H2 Loading Handshake completion. Driver submits waybill photo, seal number, seal photo, visual count. Queues Hedera pickup receipt anchor task.

nodes.label: POST /trips/{id}/handshakes/h3/complete Endpoint
nodes.description: H3 Origin Gate-Out completion. Driver submits gate exit photo, seal verification. Confirms Pulsit geofence departure, transitions to in_transit.

nodes.label: POST /trips/{id}/handshakes/h4/complete Endpoint
nodes.description: H4 Destination Gate-In completion. Driver submits gate entry photo, seal number. Compares against H2 seal. If mismatch: creates SEAL_MISMATCH exception, transitions to exception_hold.

nodes.label: POST /trips/{id}/handshakes/h5/complete Endpoint
nodes.description: H5 Unloading Handshake (closes trip). Driver submits POD photo, visual count, destination Parcel Perfect scan-in count. Reconciles three counts, queues Hedera delivery anchor.

nodes.label: GET /trips/{id}/handshakes/{type} Polling Endpoint
nodes.description: Polling endpoint for H2 Step 1 loading status and H5 Step 3 scan-in count. Returns HandshakeEventRead. Driver PWA polls every 4 seconds.

nodes.label: POST /trips/{id}/checkpoints Endpoint
nodes.description: Log in-transit checkpoint. Driver submits phone GPS, horse GPS (from Pulsit), selfie artifact, optional cargo photo, optional note. Adds to daily Merkle batch.

nodes.label: GET /trips/{id}/checkpoints Endpoint
nodes.description: Checkpoint history for dispatcher timeline tab. No pagination (bounded per trip). Returns list[CheckpointRead].

nodes.label: POST /trips/{id}/exceptions Endpoint
nodes.description: Driver raises exception. Submits exception_type, description, optional supporting_artifact_id. Returns TripExceptionRead. Fires dispatcher alert.

nodes.label: GET /exceptions Endpoint
nodes.description: Global exception list for dispatcher triage. Query params: resolved (bool), severity, source, exception_type, trip_id, from_date, to_date, page, page_size. Filtered to caller's org.

nodes.label: POST /exceptions/{id}/resolve Endpoint
nodes.description: Mark exception resolved with resolver_note. Dispatcher only. Returns TripExceptionRead.

nodes.label: POST /exceptions/{id}/override Endpoint
nodes.description: Dispatcher override to allow trip past failing check. Submits override_note. Returns TripDetailResponse with updated HandshakeEvent status.

nodes.label: POST /artifacts Endpoint
nodes.description: Upload photo or document. Multipart form: file, trip_id, artifact_type, captured_lat (optional), captured_lng (optional), captured_at. Computes SHA-256, stores to Supabase. Max 10MB.

nodes.label: GET /drivers Endpoint
nodes.description: Active driver list for trip creation dropdown. Query: search (name/license), page, page_size. Filtered to caller's org.

nodes.label: GET /vehicles Endpoint
nodes.description: Vehicle list (horse/trailer). Query: vehicle_type, search (registration), page, page_size. For trip creation dropdowns.

nodes.label: GET /precincts Endpoint
nodes.description: Precinct list for origin/destination selectors. Query: search (name), page, page_size.

nodes.label: GET /templates Endpoint
nodes.description: Trip templates for 'Use template' toggle. Query: is_active (default true), page, page_size.

nodes.label: Trip Model
nodes.description: Core trip record. Fields: trip_reference, order_number, status (enum), idvs_check_status, driver_id, horse_id, journey_lock_hash, planned/actual timestamps.

nodes.label: TripTrailer Model
nodes.description: Junction table linking trips to trailers. Stores pulsit_device_id_snapshot at creation to prevent retroactive vehicle reassignment.

nodes.label: HandshakeEvent Model
nodes.description: Handshake event record. Fields: trip_id, handshake_type, sequence_number, status (enum). One row per handshake phase.

nodes.label: BlockchainReceipt Model
nodes.description: Hedera HCS receipt record. Fields: topic_id, sequence_number, consensus_timestamp, tx_id. One per anchored handshake (H0, H2, H5).

nodes.label: Trip Service (Orchestration)
nodes.description: create_trip() orchestration function. All business logic for trip creation: validation, DB writes, hash computation, blockchain anchoring.

nodes.label: Hashing Service
nodes.description: compute_journey_lock_hash() function. Builds canonical dict of immutable trip fields, sorts keys, JSON serialises, SHA-256 hashes. Returns 64-char hex.

nodes.label: Hedera Anchor Service
nodes.description: anchor_subject() orchestration function. Calls HederaService.submit_hash() to submit SHA-256 to HCS topic, receives receipt, saves BlockchainReceipt row.

nodes.label: get_current_dispatcher Auth Dependency
nodes.description: FastAPI auth dependency. In DEMO_MODE=True returns fixed stub dispatcher user. When DEMO_MODE=False raises 401. Real JWT auth replaces only the body.

nodes.label: TripCreateRequest Schema
nodes.description: Pydantic v2 model for POST /trips payload. Fields: order_number, client_organization_id, driver_id, horse_id, trailer_ids, origin_precinct_id, destination_precinct_id, template_id, timestamps.

nodes.label: TripDetailResponse Schema
nodes.description: Response schema for POST /trips and GET /trips/{id}. Includes nested driver/horse/trailers, handshakes list, exceptions list, blockchain_receipts list.

nodes.label: TripConflictError Exception
nodes.description: Raised when a trip with the given order_number is already active. Carries order_number. Maps to HTTP 409 Conflict.

nodes.label: ResourceNotFoundError Exception
nodes.description: Raised when a required DB record (driver/horse/trailer/precinct) not found or inactive. Carries resource type and ID. Maps to HTTP 404 Not Found.

nodes.label: Dispatcher Portal Surface
nodes.description: Next.js dashboard for logistics operators. Trip creation, active trips list, history, manifest tab, timeline, exceptions triage.

nodes.label: Driver PWA Surface
nodes.description: Next.js PWA for drivers. Handshake capture app with Capacitor Android APK and browser PWA (Workbox via @serwist/next). Static export (output: 'export').

nodes.label: Guard Page Surface
nodes.description: Plain HTML + JS. Zero login, zero install. Guard scans QR code to verify trip details.

nodes.label: FastAPI Backend
nodes.description: Python 3.13, FastAPI 0.115+, SQLAlchemy 2.0 async, Alembic, Celery.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Database
nodes.description: PostgreSQL 16 (Supabase for dev, AWS RDS af-south-1 for prod). Personal data stays in af-south-1 (POPIA compliance). Async driver: asyncpg.

nodes.label: Redis Cache & Queue
nodes.description: Redis 7, Celery. Used for after-commit pub/sub (realtime.py), background task queueing, caching.

nodes.label: Hedera HCS Blockchain
nodes.description: Hedera Hashgraph Consensus Service via REST API. Anchors SHA-256 hashes of trip parameters and handshake events. Public, immutable ledger for evidence.

nodes.label: Supabase Storage
nodes.description: S3 / Supabase Storage for photos and evidence files. Evidence artifacts are hashed before storage.

nodes.label: Next.js 15 Frontend
nodes.description: Next.js 15 App Router, TypeScript 5.5, React 19, Tailwind CSS v3.4. No Pages Router, no deprecated APIs.

nodes.label: JWT Authentication
nodes.description: Two token types: Dispatcher JWT (email+password, User table) and Driver JWT (phone OTP, Driver table). Both validated by shared dependency. Endpoints declare auth via FastAPI Depends.

nodes.label: POPIA Data Compliance

nodes.label: WP2: Server-side reconciliation

nodes.label: Seal

nodes.label: H0: Trip Creation

nodes.label: H1: Origin Gate-In

nodes.label: H2: Loading Handshake

nodes.label: H3: Origin Gate-Out

nodes.label: H4: Destination Gate-In

nodes.label: H5: Unloading Handshake

nodes.label: Seal mismatch exception
nodes.description: Recorded when seal at arrival doesn't match seal captured at origin. Critical severity. Indicates potential cargo tampering in transit.

nodes.label: Checkpoint
